title: Manager-executed Slice tasks when no worker session is attached
problem: Worker slots AGENT-01..10 are open (DEC-0010), but a worker is a separate Arena session that only the owner can open (#269). With no worker session attached, a Slice task can reach READY_FOR_REVIEW only through a worker lease (TASK_ASSIGN ... TASK_READY_FOR_REVIEW). The DEC-0011 manager-executed path covers GOVERNANCE tasks only. Approved Slices therefore could not be delivered unless the Manager impersonated a worker slot, which is forbidden.

options.summary: The Manager may execute a Slice task itself when no worker session is attached: TASK_MANAGER_EXECUTED moves an UNASSIGNED slice task to READY_FOR_REVIEW with the exact head SHA, recorded as executor MANAGER (never a worker slot). Everything after that is unchanged: one delivery PR, exact-head CI, merge, fresh-main verification, the 8-point SLICE_COMPLETE gate and DEC-0015 runner verification.
Leave Slice tasks UNASSIGNED until the owner opens worker sessions; the Manager does no Slice work.
The Manager runs worker commands under an AGENT-xx identity.

rationale: The owner instructed the Manager to continue until all tasks are done ("lanjutkan sampai semua task selesai") and the marathon prompt forbids stopping at planning. B would stall all approved work for as long as no worker session is attached. C falsifies attribution and is rejected. A keeps attribution honest: the executor is recorded as MANAGER with reason NO_WORKER_SESSION, and no worker slot, lease or agent state is touched. The Slice delivery rules (DEC-0014) and two-phase verification (DEC-0015) are not reduced. Worker sessions remain the preferred executors: a task claimed by a worker can never be manager-executed, and a manager-executed task may not overlap the scope paths of a task a worker currently holds.
